author: CMS and LHCb Collaborations
title: Combination of results on the rare decays $B^0_{(s)} \\to \\mu^+ \\mu^-$ from the CMS and LHCb experiments
abstract: A combination of results on the rare decays $B^0_{(s)} \\to \\mu^+ \\mu^-$ from the CMS and LHCb experiments is performed. The analysis is based on data collected in 2011 and 2012. The branching fraction of the $B^0_s \\to \\mu^+ \\mu^-$ decay is measured to be $(2.8 \\pm 0.7) \\times 10^{-9}$, and an upper limit of $3.4 \\times 10^{-10}$ is set on the $B^0 \\to \\mu^+ \\mu^-$ branching fraction at 95% confidence level.
